domain.name: Radiation-Induced Somatic Mutation
domain.description: Entities and relationships describing the somatic mutations produced by low-dose ionising radiation, their mutational signatures, and their role in clonal evolution.
domain.guiding_question: What somatic mutations does low-dose radiation induce and how do they contribute to clonal expansion and cancer initiation?

entity_types.name: MUTATION_TYPE
entity_types.description: Class of somatic mutation (SNV, indel, SV, CNV)

entity_types.name: MUTATIONAL_SIGNATURE
entity_types.description: COSMIC or de novo signature associated with radiation

entity_types.name: DRIVER_GENE
entity_types.description: Gene whose mutation confers clonal fitness advantage

entity_types.name: CLONE
entity_types.description: Clonally expanded cell population carrying shared mutations

entity_types.name: TISSUE
entity_types.description: Tissue or organ in which somatic mutations accumulate

relationship_types.name: INDUCES_SIGNATURE
relationship_types.description: Radiation induces a specific mutational signature

relationship_types.name: EXPANDS
relationship_types.description: A driver mutation causes clonal expansion

relationship_types.name: ENRICHED_IN
relationship_types.description: A mutation type is enriched in a specific tissue after radiation

queries: radiation induced somatic mutation clonal expansion COSMIC signature site:pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov
ionising radiation mutational spectrum whole genome sequencing site:pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov OR site:nature.com
